message.content:
**Paris Get‑away: A 7‑Day Adventure (Mid‑April 2025)**  
*(Feel free to swap dates or tweak the itinerary to fit your own schedule and interests.)*

---

## 1️⃣ Quick Snapshot

| Item | Details |
|------|---------|
| **Duration** | 7 days (6 nights) |
| **Best Time to Visit** | Late March – early May (mild weather, fewer crowds than summer) |
| **Estimated Budget** | €1,200–€2,000 per person (mid‑range) |
| **Travel Mode** | Flight to Charles de Gaulle (CDG) or Orly (ORY) → Paris city center |
| **Accommodation** | 3‑star boutique hotel or Airbnb in Le Marais or Saint‑Germain |
| **Transport in Paris** | Unlimited 7‑day Navigo pass (€22.80) + occasional metro/Bus |
| **Currency** | Euro (€) – use contactless card or travel card |

---

## 2️⃣ Flights & Arrival

| Step | What to Do |
|------|------------|
| **Book Early** | Look for flights 3–4 months in advance. Use fare alerts (Google Flights, Skyscanner). |
| **Airport Transfer** | From CDG: RER B to Gare du Nord (≈35 min, €10). From ORY: Orlyval + RER B (≈45 min, €12). |
| **Check‑in** | Most hotels offer 24‑hour reception. If staying in an Airbnb, arrange a key‑pickup or use a lockbox. |
| **First Night** | Grab a croissant & café au lait at a local boulangerie. Take a gentle stroll along the Seine to soak in the city’s vibe. |

---

## 3️⃣ Accommodation Options

| Budget | Example Property | Why It’s Great |
|--------|------------------|----------------|
| **€70–€120/night** | Hotel Le Petit Paris (Le Marais) | 2‑star, central, free Wi‑Fi, breakfast included. |
| **€120–€180/night** | Hôtel Henriette (Saint‑Germain) | 3‑star, boutique feel, close to Notre‑Dame & Louvre. |
| **€180–€250/night** | Hôtel Le Six (Latin Quarter) | 4‑star, stylish rooms, rooftop terrace. |
| **Airbnb** | 1‑bedroom loft in Montmartre | €90–€140/night, local vibe, kitchen access. |

*Tip:* Book a place with a kitchenette if you want to save on meals.

---

## 4️⃣ Daily Itinerary (Sample)

> **Day 1 – Arrival & Orientation**  
> • Check‑in & freshen up.  
> • Walk to **Place des Vosges** (Le Marais).  
> • Dinner at **Le Petit Cler** (French bistro).  

> **Day 2 – Classic Landmarks**  
> • Morning: **Eiffel Tower** (book skip‑the‑line tickets online).  
> • Lunch at **58 Tour Eiffel** (view + cuisine).  
> • Afternoon: **Champs‑Élysées** → **Arc de Triomphe**.  
> • Evening: Seine river cruise (Bateaux Mouches).  

> **Day 3 – Art & Culture**  
> • Louvre Museum (early opening, 9 am).  
> • Lunch at **Café Marly** (inside Louvre).  
> • Walk to **Tuileries Garden** → **Place de la Concorde**.  
> • Evening: **Montmartre** – Sacré‑Coeur, artists’ square.  

> **Day 4 – Day Trip**  
> • **Versailles Palace** (RER C).  
> • Explore the gardens, Grand Trianon, and the Hall of Mirrors.  
> • Return to Paris for dinner at **Le Comptoir du Relais**.  

> **Day 5 – Hidden Gems**  
> • **Canal Saint‑Martin** brunch at **Café Charlot**.  
> • Visit **Musée d’Orsay** (Impressionist masterpieces).  
> • Explore **Le Marais** boutiques & vintage shops.  
> • Sunset at **Pont Alexandre III**.  

> **Day 6 – Modern & Shopping**  
> • **Centre Pompidou** (modern art).  
> • Lunch at **Le Georges** (roof‑top restaurant).  
> • Shopping on **Rue Saint‑Honoré** & **Galeries Lafayette**.  
> • Evening: **Opera Garnier** – book a show or take a guided tour.  

> **Day 7 – Relax & Departure**  
> • Brunch at **Ladurée** (famous macarons).  
> • Stroll through **Jardin du Luxembourg**.  
> • Last‑minute souvenir shopping.  
> • Head to the airport (allow 2 hrs before flight).  

---

## 5️⃣ Must‑Try Food & Drinks

| Dish | Where to Try |
|------|--------------|
| Croissants & Pain au Chocolat | Boulangerie Poilâne |
| Escargots | L’Arpège (Michelin 3‑star) |
| Steak Frites | Le Relais de l’Entrecôte |
| Crêpes | Crêperie Bretonne |
| Macarons | Ladurée, Pierre Hermé |
| French Cheese & Wine | Fromagerie Barthélemy |
| Café au Lait | Café de Flore (Saint‑Germain) |

*Pro tip:* Order “**un café**” (black coffee) to avoid the “café latte” that costs more.

---

## 6️⃣ Transportation Inside Paris

| Mode | Cost | Notes |
|------|------|-------|
| **Navigo Week Pass** | €22.80 | Unlimited metro, RER, bus, tram. Covers zones 1‑5 (city + suburbs). |
| **Metro** | €1.90 per ride (single ticket) | Use contactless card; tap on/off. |
| **Bike Share (Vélib’)** | €1.90 per 30 min | Great for short trips; helmets available. |
| **Taxi / Ride‑Share** | €30–€50 (short trips) | Use Uber or local taxi apps. |
| **Walking** | Free | Many attractions are within walking distance. |

---

## 7️⃣ Packing Checklist

| Category | Items |
|----------|-------|
| **Clothing** | Light jacket, sweater, comfortable walking shoes, umbrella, scarf (Paris can be breezy). |
| **Electronics** | Phone, charger, power adapter (Type C/E), portable power bank. |
| **Travel Docs** | Passport, visa (if needed), travel insurance, flight tickets, hotel confirmation. |
| **Health** | Basic first aid kit, prescription meds, hand sanitizer. |
| **Misc** | Reusable water bottle, small daypack, guidebook or offline map app. |

---

## 8️⃣ Money & Safety Tips

| Tip | Why It Matters |
|-----|----------------|
| **Use a contactless card** | Faster, safer, and often cheaper than cash. |
| **Avoid tourist ATMs** | Higher fees; use banks or credit cards. |
| **Keep valuables secure** | Use a money belt or hidden pouch. |
| **Beware of pickpockets** | Especially near metro stations, Eiffel Tower, and the Louvre. |
| **Learn basic French phrases** | “Bonjour”, “Merci”, “Où est…?” – locals appreciate the effort. |

---

## 9️⃣ Optional Extras

| Activity | Cost | Why Do It? |
|----------|------|------------|
| **Seine Dinner Cruise** | €35–€60 | Romantic view of illuminated landmarks. |
| **Wine Tasting in Montmartre** | €25 | Sample French wines & cheeses. |
| **Cooking Class** | €80 | Learn to make croissants or coq au vin. |
| **Day Trip to Giverny** | €30 | Monet’s house & gardens. |
| **Nightlife in Pigalle** | €10–€20 | Live music, cabaret shows. |

---

## 10️⃣ Final Checklist Before You Go

1. **Confirm flights & accommodation.**  
2. **Print or download tickets** (e.g., Eiffel Tower, Louvre).  
3. **Set up a travel itinerary** in a note app or Google Calendar.  
4. **Check weather forecast** a week before departure.  
5. **Pack light** – you’ll be walking a lot.  
6. **Notify your bank** of travel dates to avoid card blocks.  
7. **Download offline maps** (Google Maps offline or Citymapper).  

---

### 🎉 Bon voyage!  
Enjoy the lights, the art, the food, and the romance of Paris. If you’d like a more tailored plan (e.g., specific dates, budget tweaks, or a focus on art vs. food), just let me know!
